system.description: You and a willing creature clasp hands over a flame or a sharp blade, and it gives its word freely.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, and you will know at once if the vow is broken.
outcomes.success: The promise is woven into its life-thread. If it knowingly breaks the vow, it becomes Doomed.
outcomes.failure: The ritual fails; the words are only words.
outcomes.ruin: The vow binds you as well: if the promise is broken, you are both Doomed. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
